fields.title: Supplements
fields.description: A category that includes products designed to support hair health from within, providing essential vitamins, minerals, and nutrients to promote stronger, thicker, and healthier hair.

fields.title: Therapy
fields.description: A category focused on treatments and products that help restore, repair, and maintain hair and scalp health, addressing issues such as damage, dryness, hair loss, and scalp conditions.

fields.title: Book Fantasy
fields.description: A category that includes works set in imaginary worlds, featuring magic, mythical creatures, and epic adventures. These stories often depict the struggle between good and evil and heroes with special abilities.

fields.title: Book Humor
fields.description: A category that brings together books with a comedic tone, created to entertain and amuse readers through wit, satire, irony, or funny situations.
